notes.title: V1.1.0 Update Announcement
notes.notes: [h1]V1.1.0 is live! [/h1][p][/p][p]New Boss, settings, refreshed Colored Trinket Packs, and more await. Details below![/p][p][/p][p]We're planning further optimizations and features like Batch Field Expansion, blocking lethal self-damage cards, long-press continuous card drawing, disabling Trinkets, Quick Play for specific cards, and ongoing fixes for lag in certain playstyles. [/p][p][/p][p]We'll keep tweaking balance and playability! Thanks for supporting our two-person team![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]V1.1.0 Changelog[/h2][p][/p][h3]New Additions[/h3][olist][*][p]Added Massive Cataclysms \[Descent] to Endless Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Settings - Gameplay - Maximum Number of Products on the Field to adjust Product play speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Settings - Visuals - Hide Gold Animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Settings - Visuals - Hide Product-to-Bag Animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Trinket Pack refresh, enabling one refresh per trinket-pack opening.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3]Adjustments & Optimizations[/h3][olist][*][p]\[Bouillon Bag] now accurately shows its generated \[Chicken Bouillon] cards.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased node count in Stage 3 for better progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Streamlined auto-draw logic for \[Temporary Time Scale Limit]: stops drawing when \[Dangerous Cards] exceed 0.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced visual design of select UI buttons for better clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered sound effect volume for endgame scoring and story interface exits.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed \[Larva] and non-disaster-year \[Bug] mechanics (e.g., Dozy Bug, Woodborer, Black Hole Bug, Dizzy Bug, Parasite, Leech Bug, Locust).[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked \[Imperial Jade] into a Product card with improved gold generation.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted \[Dewdrop Vending Machine] to an early/mid-game event, now allowing debt purchases.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized performance for \[Full Gift] and \[Chaos Mushroom] during Product generation.[/p][/*][*][p]\[Year-End Bonus] total count now supports a wider range of numerical values.[/p][/*][*][p]Total Revenue during Endgame Scoring now supports a wider range of numerical values.[/p][/*][*][p]Boosted overall game performance for smoother runtime.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded \[Field Zoom] display to support finer scale adjustments.[/p][/*][*][p]Eliminated lag when accessing the play record interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced performance delays when loading/saving with many Products.[/p][/*][*][p]Mitigated lag from stacking multiple \[Pig]s.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][olist][*][p]Resolved message prompt icon showing default emoji (yellow bean face) incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected gold accumulation displaying as negative during rapid increases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Yearly Revenue] incorrectly showing as negative.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Yearly Revenue] values appearing as negative.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed \[Yearly Revenue] numbers overflowing the display box when too long.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed inventory card details tooltip lingering on screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected A or D key presses unintentionally triggering \[Field Zoom].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Chrysanthemum King] counter showing negative values.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed deprecated \[Sack of Gold] Trinket from Codex display.[/p][/*][*][p]Aligned \[Ore Bag] card description with its actual effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed abnormal field display when entering \[Tutorial] right after game start.[/p][/*][*][p]Ensured plant cards gray out (unusable) immediately after reaching Harvests This Turn limit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game entry failure after selecting \[Starting Effects: Starting HP -30%, Receive a Blue Card Pack].[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented field objects from being moved through the map interface after closing the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Starting Effects] persisting incorrectly when switching save files.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected \[Chicken Bouillon] Product icon displaying as \[Dewdrop].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Primal Stone] event allowing two card deletions on second trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected shop interface HP display exceeding max HP after event-driven HP cap changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Mill Two] card effect freezing game flow when no cards remain in the deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Aligned \[Bouillon Bag] activation timing with its description.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved issue where turns failed to end properly in specific cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved an issue where item attributes could incorrectly stack multiple times after upgrades or transformations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the final unlockable content could be repeatedly triggered in certain scenarios.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3]Bug Reporting & Save File Submission[/h3][p]If you encounter issues during gameplay, providing your current game save file is the fastest way for us to identify and fix problems. [/p][p][/p][p]To send your save file:[/p][olist][*][p]Press [b]Win+R[/b] to open the Run window.[/p][/*][*][p]Enter [b]%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/VisionRana/RanaCard[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Zip all contents of the folder and upload the compressed file.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Bug Reporting & Save File Upload: [/p][p]If you encounter any issues or want to dive deeper into the [i]Rana Card[/i] world, join our official [url="https://discord.com/invite/GqfH4dybYU"]Discord Channel[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We truly appreciate your feedback and support in helping us make [i]Rana Card[/i] better![/p]

notes.title: V1.0.17 Patch Update
notes.notes:
[h1][b]V1.0.17 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]A new update with fixes and optimizations! We're tackling card settlement lag and slowness—apologies, QAQ! These will be resolved soon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Latest Version: V1.0.17[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]Removed "Trial Version" text from the bottom-right corner of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mouse cursor disappearing when pressing the menu key while playing a card requiring target selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed card duplication when pressing the end-turn key while playing a card requiring target selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where playing \[Mill Two] during Product settlement at turn start caused the game to freeze on the discard interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing confirm button in Endless Mode despite selecting a buff.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pressing spacebar during chest reward scrolling causing rewards to be consumed or the interface to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed exploit allowing free shovel purchase and plot expansion by rapidly entering/exiting the shop.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Product × 0" appearing in the bag.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect level display for \[Chicken Bouillon].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed gold coin icon for \[Time Scale] 1 & 2 being replaced with a soybean emoji.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed save loading causing fewer cards in the inventory in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed KPI turning negative in later Endless Mode stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shop selling the wrong card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed double-clicking to skip settlement animation preventing stars from being saved.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Crystal Lizard] numerical overflow causing zero rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed excessive \[Panda] cards causing negative Gold display.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Raindrop Eggplant Plantation] not appearing in the card pool.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rapid turn-end with excessive \[Egg] cards causing negative egg rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shop gold refresh overflowing to negative values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed chest gold rewards overflowing to negative values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clicking the shovel in the shop mistakenly purchasing the rightmost card.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed \[Stone Mission] trinket effect vanishing after save load.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]Adjustments & Optimizations[/b][/h3][olist][*][p]The mysterious character in the ending Easter egg now gracefully exits after clicking the leave button, avoiding any creepy "headless wanderer" animation glitches.[/p][/*][*][p]If you don’t have the \[Frog Statue], the stall merchant will no longer stop you (preventing subsequent events).[/p][/*][*][p]Play history is now displayed in reverse chronological order.[/p][/*][*][p]Similar buffs are now combined for display.[/p][/*][*][p]More ways to earn "stars" during endgame scoring: one "star" is now awarded for each boss defeated in regular stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the number of \[Egg] required to obtain \[Chicken Bouillon] from the \[Bouillon Bag].[/p][/*][*][p]\[Chicken Bouillon]’s type changed to Product.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the description of \[Thorned Staff].[/p][/*][*][p]In case of corrupted save files, the backup save will automatically overwrite the corrupted save to restore it.
[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Bug Reporting & Save File Submission[/h3][p]If you encounter issues during gameplay, providing your current game save file is the fastest way for us to identify and fix problems. [/p][p][/p][p]To send your save file:[/p][olist][*][p]Press [b]Win+R[/b] to open the Run window.[/p][/*][*][p]Enter [b]%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/VisionRana/RanaCard[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Zip all contents of the folder and upload the compressed file.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Bug Reporting & Save File Upload: [/p][p]If you encounter any issues or want to dive deeper into the [i]Rana Card[/i] world, join our official [url="https://discord.com/invite/GqfH4dybYU"]Discord Channel[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We truly appreciate your feedback and support in helping us make [i]Rana Card[/i] better![/p]

notes.title: V1.0.6 Patch Update
notes.notes: [h1][b]V1.0.6 Patch Notes[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your incredible support and love for [i]Rana Card[/i]! We deeply apologize for the bugs that have affected some players’ experience. Our team has worked overnight to release this update with fixes and adjustments to improve your gameplay. Below are the details of the changes in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Latest Version: V1.0.6[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][olist][*][p]Fixed an issue where the description of \[Diamond Growth Booster] did not match its actual effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that could cause turn skipping during Cataclysmic Years.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where \[Gamble Contract] was not taking effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug in Casual Mode where clearing the game did not unlock subsequent classes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where upgraded plants in a match were still marked as "unencountered" in the Codex.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Codex showed encountered items as "unlocked" but still displayed them as locked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where, after opening a card pack or trinket pack, players could click the map below to enter a node.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the keyboard shortcuts prompt did not update after modifying shortcuts.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]Adjustments[/h2][olist][*][p]Reduced KPI requirements for Difficulty 0-3.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced KPI requirements for Harsh Years in Difficulty 0-7.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced KPI requirements for Casual Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced KPI requirements for Stages 2 and 3 across all difficulties.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced KPI requirements for Difficulty 0-3 (additional adjustment).[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the difficulty of \[Juicing] during Harsh Years.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the effect of the \[Improved Raindrop] trinket.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reduced the negative effect of \[All-In].[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the coin yield of \[Raindrop Mushroom].[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly increased the growth cycle and effect of \[Raindrop Eggplant].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the coin yield of \[Fuseball Fungus].[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Reporting & Save File Submission[/h2][p]If you encounter issues during gameplay, providing your current game save file is the fastest way for us to identify and fix problems. [/p][p][/p][p]To send your save file:[/p][olist][*][p]Press [b]Win+R[/b] to open the Run window.[/p][/*][*][p]Enter [b]%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/VisionRana/RanaCard[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Zip all contents of the folder and upload the compressed file.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Bug Reporting & Save File Upload: [/p][p]If you encounter any issues or want to dive deeper into the [i]Rana Card[/i] world, join our official [url="https://discord.com/invite/GqfH4dybYU"]Discord Channel[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]We truly appreciate your feedback and support in helping us make [i]Rana Card[/i] better![/p]

notes.title: Release Date Update!!!
notes.notes: [p]Hey friends![/p][p]We come bearing... BIG news! [/p][p][/p][p]Our original plan was to release the [b]Rana Card[/b] on September 9th. But fate had other plans—and played a wild card: [b]Silksong is dropping on September 4th![/b][/p][p][/p][p]To give you all enough room to [strike]dive into that adventure[/strike] (and okay, yes, some market factors too), we’ve decided to shift Rana Card's release date to [b]September 16th[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support and understanding! We’ll be using this extra time to polish the game so that Rana Card lands in its greatest shape on the 16th! [/p][p][/p][p]—VisionRana Studio[/p]
